description: The machine's test-slot hook (Proyectos/.claude/scripts/testslot/proyectos_test_slot.py line 120) sets pytest to BELOW_NORMAL and a child inherits its parent's class: simgolf_port.exe ran BelowNormal under pytest (Get-Process during test_app_ingame), so the host's ABOVE_NORMAL sim thread ranked below every normal-priority thread. Under 10 busy processes at normal priority (14_load.py) the frame waits ended 1-5 s late with about 0 ms of thread CPU (diagnostic build, waits.tsv columns 9..), and d66aa755 failed with I12's TimeoutError. At the machine's ambient load the S3 tree failed test_pacing_under_ingame_load in 3 of 15 sessions (a frame without a terrain pass held off-CPU 82..442 ms), d66aa755 in 0 of 6. Fixed in the harness: the app starts in the Normal class (an Explorer launch's class); SG_APP_PRIORITY=inherit is the control. The off-CPU stalls at Normal class were not measured to zero: every session of the fixed tree at Normal class passed (test_app_ingame and test_app_live in full, the gates' app step, two sessions under 10 busy processes), which bounds but does not exclude them.
needed: if the app files fail again on pacing: check the app's PriorityClass and the machine's load first; a host that pins its own class (SetPriorityClass in the app) is the alternative to the harness flag

description: The drivers took 1.5 s without a new present as the title menu. The location screen after the Sandbox click is still found by 1.5 s of quiet; no run lost the Monterey click, and no load pump between the two screens was seen in dispatches.tsv.
